subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The same red robot with the same simple rounded shape and eye pattern persists across all shots.

background_coherent.rationale: All shots remain in the same gray studio-like setting with the slanted floor line and recurring yellow/black background elements, despite viewpoint shifts.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Closer angled view is plausible, though the studio mark/returning action is only weakly visible in the single frame.
Wide gray-studio view with the red robot standing is well matched.
Same studio and robot are present; side-view/moving cue is suggested by the shifted composition and dark ground mark, but the robot remains fairly front-facing.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The shots preserve distinct framing and viewpoint differences rather than collapsing to the same composition.

motion_continuity.rationale: Robot position and framing change across shots in a way compatible with viewpoint and movement changes, though only one frame per shot limits temporal evidence.

which_cut_broke.how: No transition clearly breaks subject or scene consistency.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are not copied or frozen; they show legitimate composition and viewpoint variation.
